title: Trick or Treat Events
description: A pack that adds NPCs that can either give you a treat or a nasty trick...
body:
**Don't you love to Trick or Treat? Well, now it is in Minecraft!**

---

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/0ku32D3mhps" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

This data pack adds Residents that spawn around you every minute, that you can choose to right-click on to receive a trick or a treat! Tricks are small mini-games with different goals to complete! (Survive a water bucket clutch, parkour to the top before the lava rises, outlast the anvils, etc.) You receive treats based on how far you are in the game! (Advancements, like mining diamonds, visiting the nether, and traveling through an end gateway, give you a chance for better treats!) If you complete a trick, you still receive a treat as a reward!

**Do you want to add to this data pack yourself? Well, go for it!**

---

I created this as more of a proof of concept than a 100% perfect data pack, but if you see somewhere you can improve upon it, go for it! Someone else had made an AFK farm for this data pack! It's cool, and it contains all these helpful toggleable settings too! Here's the link: https://www.planetminecraft.com/project/afk-treat-farm/
